history.content: Is there a benefit to a Content Delivery Network?

Yes, there are several benefits to using a Content Delivery Network (CDN). A CDN can improve the loading time of web content by caching it on Edge servers located in various regions around the world. When a customer requests content, it is routed to the Edge server closest to them, which reduces the distance the content must travel. This results in optimized throughput, minimized latency, and enhanced performance, ultimately leading to a better overall experience for your customers. 
Additionally, a CDN can efficiently deliver content from around the globe with minimal configuration required. You can utilize IBM Cloud® Content Delivery Network (CDN) for various industry solutions, such as media, entertainment, software, gaming, banking, and e-commerce, to meet the specific needs of your business. IBM Cloud has partnered with Akamai to provide comprehensive CDN features while ensuring affordability.
How is my IBM Cloud® Content Delivery Network service account created?

Your IBM Cloud® Content Delivery Network service account is created during the CDN ordering process. Specifically, when you click the Order CDN button in the legacy portal under the Network > CDN page or click the Create button in the IBM Cloud portal under the Catalog > Network > Content Delivery Network page, your account will be generated.
What are the estimated costs for a CDN?

You can estimate the cost of a Content Delivery Network (CDN) service by using the cost estimator available on the provisioning pages for CDN offerings. For IBM Cloud's Content Delivery Network, log in to the console at <https://cloud.ibm.com/catalog/infrastructure/cdn-powered-by-akamai> and click on "Create." As you fill out the ordering form, cost estimates will appear in the Summary side panel. The final cost will depend on the specific configuration and usage of the CDN service.
Do I need a credit card?
Do you have a tutorial available?
Yes, use the Cost Estimator to generate a cost estimate based on your projected usage. Please be aware that this tutorial may incur costs.
How do I add a CNAME record for my CDN domain in DNS?

To add a CNAME record for your CDN domain in DNS, please follow these steps:
1. Access your DNS configuration page for your CDN domain.
2. Create a new CNAME record.
3. Set the Host field to your CDN domain name.
4. Set the CNAME field to the IBM CNAME you used to configure the CDN.
Once you have completed these steps, it may take up to 15 to 30 minutes for the changes to take effect. Please note that the exact time frame may vary depending on your DNS provider.

To remove a CNAME record for your CDN domain in DNS, follow these steps:
1. Access your DNS configuration page for your CDN domain.
2. Locate the CNAME record you want to remove.
3. Delete the CNAME record.
After completing these steps, it may take up to 15 to 30 minutes for the changes to take effect. Again, the exact time frame may vary depending on your DNS provider.
User: How do I delete a CDN?
Assistant: To delete a CDN, follow these steps:
1. Click 'Delete' from the Overflow ![Overflow menu](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/images/overflow.png) menu. A confirmation window appears.
2. Click 'Delete' to proceed.
3. When the delete process is complete, click 'Get status' from the Overflow menu to remove the row from the CDN list. If the delete process has not completed, this action has no effect.
Please note that deleting a CDN does not delete your account. It only deletes the specific CDN.
